# Corpus API — `api/index.json` contract

> **TL;DR:** `api/index.json` is a machine-readable dump of the bible's
> metadata: one record per chapter with path, title, section, category,
> tags and computed read minutes. It is generated by
> `scripts/gen_master_index.py` (never hand-edited), byte-locked by gate 14,
> and timestamp-free so consumers get deterministic diffs. Intended
> consumers: `repos/resume-generator` (cite chapters as skill evidence) and
> `repos/docita` (pick drill topics, render canonical links).

## Shape

```json
{
  "source":    "generated by scripts/gen_master_index.py … do not edit",
  "consumers": ["repos/resume-generator", "repos/docita"],
  "totals":    { "chapters": 560, "sections": 47, "categories": 13,
                 "read_minutes": 10565 },
  "chapters": [
    { "p": "20-backend/20.4-database/01-postgresql-foundations/20.4.1.03-mvcc.html",
      "t": "MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control)",
      "s": "Database", "c": "Data",
      "g": ["concept"],
      "m": 18 }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `p` | Site path (`…​.html`) — equals the repo path with the extension swapped. For repo-relative links, replace the trailing `.html` with `.md`. |
| `t` | Chapter H1 title (the same string gate 6b sees). |
| `s` / `c` | Section (from the metadata comment) and Category (one of contributing.md's canonical 14 — gate 6b enforces both). |
| `g` | Tags, lowercased, deduplicated, sorted. |
| `m` | Computed read minutes (gate 13's model; reference genres already halved). |
| `totals.read_minutes` | Sum over all chapters (divide by 60 for hours). |

**Guarantees** (all enforced, not aspirational): generated from the same
metadata gate 6b validates, so a record cannot exist for a file that fails
the template gate; minutes match gate 13's model; the file is regenerated
atomically with `search.html` and byte-compared by gate 14 on every push;
no timestamps — the same corpus produces byte-identical output, so
consumers can commit it or diff it without noise.

**Non-guarantees:** record order is alphabetical by `p`, not study order
(use the per-stack INDEX files for pedagogy order); tags are a free
vocabulary (only their presence, not their spelling, is gated).

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 scripts/gen_master_index.py        # writes search.html + api/index.json
python3 scripts/gen_master_index.py --check  # gate 14: fails on drift
```

## Consumer: `repos/resume-generator` (Python)

Cite bible chapters as evidence behind resume claims — e.g. every skill
bullet backed by the chapter that teaches it. Copy this helper into the
resume-generator repo (or vendor it) as needed:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cite bible chapters from resume bullets. Example consumer of api/index.json.
Executed against the live file 2026-09-17; output quoted below is real."""
import json, pathlib, sys

API = pathlib.Path.home() / "repos/software-developer-bible/api/index.json"

def load():
    return json.loads(API.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def find(keyword: str, data) -> list[dict]:
    """Chapters whose title/section/tags contain the keyword (case-insensitive)."""
    kw = keyword.lower()
    return [c for c in data["chapters"]
            if kw in c["t"].lower() or kw in c["s"].lower()
            or any(kw in t for t in c["g"])]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    data = load()
    hits = find(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "mvcc", data)
    for c in hits[:3]:
        repo_path = c["p"].removesuffix(".html") + ".md"
        print(f"{c['t']}  ({c['m']} min)  → {repo_path}")
```

Verified against the live file (2026-09-17): `find("mvcc", data)` prints

```
MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control)  (18 min)  -> 20-backend/20.4-database/01-postgresql-foundations/20.4.1.03-mvcc.md
```

The TypeScript example's `drillsFor` logic was executed the same way:
Kubernetes drills shortest-first resolve to StatefulSets & DaemonSets,
Jobs & CronJobs, RBAC & Network Policies.

## Consumer: `repos/docita` (TypeScript)

Pick drill topics and canonical links for a study session, filtered by
section and tagged genre:

```typescript
// api/index.json is committed or fetched; typing kept minimal on purpose
type Chapter = { p: string; t: string; s: string; c: string; g: string[]; m: number };

export function drillsFor(section: string, api: { chapters: Chapter[] }): Chapter[] {
  return api.chapters
    .filter(c => c.s === section && !c.g.includes("interview-questions"))
    .sort((a, b) => a.m - b.m);          // shortest first for a drill queue
}

export const repoLink = (c: Chapter) =>
  `https://github.com/CVamsi27/software-developer-bible/blob/main/${c.p.replace(/\.html$/, ".md")}`;
```

## Versioning

Field *removals* or type changes bump a `v` field and keep the old shape
under `api/v1/index.json` for one release cycle. Additive changes (new
optional fields) do not bump. Gate 14 keeps both the page and the API in
sync with the corpus either way.
